# Glossary of Terms

<!-- glossary:backend-protocol concepts:42 -->
#### Backend Protocol

The backend protocol defines the request/response contract between services.
<!-- /glossary:backend-protocol -->

<!-- glossary:context-object concepts:10 -->
#### Context Object

A context object supplies values evaluated against rules.
<!-- /glossary:context-object -->

<!-- glossary:learning-graph concepts:3,4 -->
#### Learning Graph

A directed graph of concepts reflecting the prerequisite order they should be learned.
<!-- /glossary:learning-graph -->
